text.en: The Sixth Schedule and Assam’s statutory council Acts are different legal foundations. The Mising, Rabha Hasong and Tiwa Acts date to 1995; Deori and Sonowal Kachari Acts to 2005. These dates describe those statutes’ origins.
text.as: ষষ্ঠ অনুসূচী আৰু অসমৰ বিধিবদ্ধ পৰিষদ আইন পৃথক আইনী ভেটি। মিচিং, ৰাভা হাছং আৰু তিৱা আইন ১৯৯৫ৰ; দেউৰী আৰু সোণোৱাল কছাৰী২০০৫ৰ। চনে সেই আইনৰ উৎপত্তি বুজায়।

text.en: On 4 September 2021 the Union and Assam governments signed a settlement with representatives of five Karbi armed groups. It included commitments about autonomy, development and the rehabilitation of former cadres.
